detailed_description:
The video is filmed in a modern, social-first editorial style on a downtown rooftop during late afternoon. The lighting is natural and even, with slight warmth in the highlights and lifted shadows that maintain an airy atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by crisp whites, creams, and deep charcoals, with the vibrant coral of the product serving as the primary pop of color. 

[Shot 1] The scene opens with a close-up detail shot of a weathered grey wooden tabletop. <Subject 1>'s hand enters the frame, holding <Subject 3>. She gracefully slides the coral lipstick <Subject 3> across the texture of the wood. Next to the lipstick lies a small, curled orange peel, creating a playful color-blocked composition against the neutral wood. The camera performs a smooth, quick overhead tracking shot following the movement of the lipstick.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up focusing on <Subject 2>. She reaches out with her hand to accept <Subject 3> as it slides toward her from <Subject 1>. The focus is sharp on the tactile finish of the matte lipstick tube and the natural skin tones of their hands. The background remains soft and clean. The sound is the light, rhythmic friction of the plastic tube moving against the wooden surface.

overall_soundscape:
The soft, dry sound of a plastic lipstick tube sliding across a textured wooden table. Subtle ambient city air in the distance.
